observed_at_registration: First seed's two official credits were already reported. Remaining 15 pairs had not begun.
method: In each Hard or Lunatic stratum shuffle the candidate-first order labels across the four registered paired seeds in each lane, keeping two per order and every observed first and second original outcome fixed. Enumerate the resulting 36 assignments exactly. Two-sided absolute paired mean difference. All eight pairs required. If an endpoint is missing, no complete-cohort p value is reported. Stage clock metrics require a common stage across both arms of every pair. Original game RNG uncontrolled.
